decisions.reason: The final sentence incorrectly conditions the ordinary module 2-category on a monoidal product unavailable for general fusion C. Composite action comparisons give ordinary functor composition without braiding; the repair states those operations explicitly.

The statement correctly asserts dh+hd=id only for n>=1, and the proof explicitly gives h1d=id-P in degree zero. The unqualified title is misleading, a nonfatal defect repaired by adding “in positive degrees”. The explicit expansions cancel using centrality and mu(e)=eta, including n=1; the missing general algebra/bimodule prerequisite is now declared.

The cited def-monad only defines endofunctor monads. The defining separability/splitting condition lacked its general 2-categorical monad data and laws. The repair supplies eta, mu, associativity, units, both section-bilinearity equations, and the 2-categorical adjunction triangles; UL is identified as a monad, preserving the splitting property.

F1 only constructs balanced products for fusion categories over algebraically closed fields, so applying it to an arbitrary finite semisimple monoidal category was unsupported. A new local proof constructs the separability projector, proves its balancing and universal property, splits it through the abelian image, and descends outer actions. Commuting projectors give iterated balanced products; universal uniqueness proves associativity, units and interchange. The full original Statement is unchanged.

The alleged reversed-domain defect is not present: O has underlying A, and after reassociation the displayed block crossings move the first input to the end for lambda and the last to the front for rho. They are not c_(L,A)^-1 or c_(A,K)^-1. There are confirmed nonfatal presentation defects: proof 1.2–1.4 and 1.5–1.6 were sentence fragments. The repair writes both actions as explicitly typed adjacent crossings and merges complete arguments. Negative/positive action permutations, balance words, unit insertions and both cusp inverses are retained; no symmetric crossing relation is used.

F1 incorrectly attributes the regular-bimodule unit theorem to a definition that only defines the regular object and balancing. The dependency on the composition theorem was already declared and used in Given, so the mathematical calculation is sound; F4 now cites that theorem for units. The separability projector is delta_(j,k), and R=M11 direct-sum M22 supplies both unit actions.

The operators act on cochains, not on tuples: (d_i f)(g_1,...,g_(n+1)) is f of the tuple after dropping an endpoint or multiplying entries i,i+1. Thus d_j^(4)d_i^(3)=d_i^(4)d_(j-1)^(3) for i<j is the correct coface identity under right-to-left composition. For example d_1 d_0 beta=d_0 d_0 beta=beta(k,l,m). The paired signs are (-1)^(i+j) and (-1)^(i+j-1), so all 15 pairs cancel. Normalization, omega(1,2,3,1)=-1, and the inverse-beta gauge are correct.

The current supplier thm-weighted-rt-tqft-and-factorization explicitly states in A1: full AC is inherited from topology and boundary duality suppliers, and countable choice from framed tangle evaluation. The interface Remarks accurately restate that attribution. Its Definition imports the supplier hypotheses and preserves the positive kappa weight, +Maslov composition and cap correction, disconnected/empty scope and both sewing inverses. It makes no physical realization claim.
